E0989

`@if` condition is not a comptime expression (D-WHEN1)

What

`@if` condition is not a comptime expression (D-WHEN1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0989

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0989: tests/ui/comptime_if_noncomptime_cond.stderr.

Error [E0989]: this `@if` condition can't be known at compile time
  --> tests/ui/comptime_if_noncomptime_cond.jet:3:9
    |
  3 |     @if x {
    |         ^
 Why: an `@if` condition must be a known-time expression — an `@` binding, a literal, or a pure function call with known arguments (D-WHEN1)
 Fix: use an `@` binding: `@flag :: …; @if flag { … }`
